name: Chrisneia Stratos
original_name: クリスネイア･ストラトス
source:
An Artifact researcher affiliated with Sephiroth.

She is Theodore's biological younger sister, and is childhood friends and best friends with Artesia, who is the same age.

She has a bright and outgoing personality, and is attached to Vasileus like a father.
The possessor of the <Lightning Bow> Artifact, which shoots lightning arrows from a lightning bow.

At Sephiroth, she specializes in the research of <Teleportation>, and serves as Theodore's assistant in the <Rod of Asclepius> project.
